newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sonepar says ING has 5 pct of Otra.
newsitem.headline: Sonepar says ING has 5 pct of Otra.

text.p: French trading company Sonepar Distribution SA said on Friday that Dutch bank-insurance group ING had bought a five percent stake in its trading unit Otra NV.
"We have been informed by ING that it has bought five percent of the (share) capital in Otra," said Sonepar, which owns 57.1 percent of Otra.
ING was unable to comment, but said it had five percent stakes in many Dutch enterprises.
"Being an insurer we have a lot of guilder interests to cover," a spokesman said.
Stakes larger than five percent in bourse-listed companies held by Dutch institutional investors are exempt from dividend tax.
Sonepar in France was also unable to comment.
